_comment: vugg-canary config. vuggPath is resolved relative to this repo root. Since 2026-10-28 (boss) it is the canary's own vugg checkout, a detached worktree of the vugg repo (README: The target). Before every full run `follow` moves it to the newest <remote>/<branch>; a run that sweeps then installs (npm ci, only when package-lock.json changed) and compiles dist/ from source. Before that, vuggPath was the vugg checkout people work in, which sat on a September branch while main moved on.
_seeds_comment: 64 since 2026-11-02 (the boss's 2026-10-28 instruction: go back up once the wall-dissolution proxy fix is in main, read off the status flag). It was 40 from 2026-10-31 and 30 from 2026-10-28, down from 200: a 200-seed sweep took 31 h at v285 (9.3 min per seed across 41 scenarios; supergene_oxidation, tn457_barite_pulses, reactive_wall and bisbee were 74% of it), so it could not finish in a night. The fix (vugg PR #41) reached main as e86ba58a. The first sweep of it took 224 min for 30 seeds on 2026-10-29 (7.2 min per seed) and the first 40-seed sweep of the same commit took 188 min on 2026-11-01 (4.6 min per seed), so the gap is that night's contention, not the code, and 64 seeds is ~5 h of the 5 h window. `npm run status` prints '⚑ seeds: ~N fit 04:00–09:00 ... go back up' when a quarter more seeds fit, and flags a sweep that overruns the night. Take the most seeds that fit and move diffThreshold.absPts with them (3 standard errors: 300*sqrt(0.5/N), i.e. 15 at 200, 27 at 64, 30 at 50, 34 at 40, 39 at 30). status.mjs flags an absPts that doesn't fit the seed count.
_autoPush_comment: After each sweep, commit logs/<date> (the spine only — .gitignore filters the heavy regenerable tiers) and push to origin (Syntaxswine) for the off-machine longitudinal record. Set false to keep the spine local-only. A push failure is non-fatal: the sweep always saves locally first.

diffThreshold._comment: Alarm if a species' spawn-% moves beyond absPts (boss decision 3), OR a rare-but-present species moves by relMult-fold (fresh-eyes addendum — catches relative swings the absolute gate misses on low-frequency phases). absPts is 3 standard errors for the seed count: 15 at 200 seeds, 39 at 30 (the boss's 2026-10-28 value), 34 at 40 (2026-10-31), 27 at 64 (2026-11-02). The 3-seed rare-species floor is also the boss's 2026-10-28 value. The floor (rel_move and appeared/disappeared) is max(minPctForRel, 100*minSeedsForRel/N) of the smaller sweep: 4.7% at 64 seeds, 7.5% at 40, 10% at 30, back to 2% at 200. On the 10-26 sweep's own seeds, disjoint 30-seed blocks of one engine raise 0.8 false alarms per pair at 39 pts / 3 seeds (mostly rel_move) vs 4.4 at 15 pts / 2%.
